questions.stem: A 55-year-old male with a history of liver cirrhosis presents to the emergency department with hematemesis and signs of shock. He is diagnosed with acute variceal bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management step for this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Administer intravenous terlipressin followed by prophylactic intravenous antibiotics

options.label: B
options.text: Start intravenous antibiotics and perform urgent endoscopy for band ligation

options.label: C
options.text: Administer intravenous vasopressin and initiate fresh frozen plasma transfusion

options.label: D
options.text: Begin intravenous corticosteroids and monitor for signs of hepatic encephalopathy
